top_signals.title: Central Asia Pushes Ahead With Regional Electricity Market
top_signals.summary: Central Asian officials are pursuing a pilot project to create a more efficient regional electricity distribution system. According to a statement issued by Kazakhstan’s state-run electric company, KEGOC, a World Bank-supported tender seeks to attract an international firm to develop and oversee a 24-month project to establish a spot electricity market for four Central Asian states – Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan. The project would involve the creation of a “trading platform and settlement system.” Implementation…
